INTRO_KR: Keppel Seghers - Zhen Hua Joint Venture is designing, building and operating Hong Kong's first integrated waste management facilities, which is scheduled for commercial operations in 2025. Situated off the coast of Shek Kwu Chau, the Hong Kong Integrated Waste Management Facilities Phase 1 (HKIWMF Phase 1) comprises 3,000 tonnes per day of advanced incineration thermal technology which reduces the volume of waste by more than 90% for significant extension of landfill lifespan, while generating more than 100MW of stable, green electrical power, thereby reducing Hong Kong's reliance on conventional fossil fuel power generation. The HKIWMF Phase 1 also includes 200 tonnes per day of mechanical treatment facility which will segregate waste into useful fractions such as ferrous / non-ferrous metals, plastics, and glass to be further reprocessed into useful products.
